name: Diba integration extra
description: Legacy D10-only bundle for DiBa Integration; pulls in add-on modules (DiBa Carousel, Responsive Wrappers) that do not yet support Drupal 11.
project_description: A dependency-only submodule of DiBa Integration that bundles extra add-on modules with legacy support (DiBa Carousel, Responsive Wrappers) that are not yet available for Drupal 11. It ships no code of its own — only an info.yml declaring dependencies — and is constrained to core ^10.3, so it cannot be enabled on Drupal 11 or 12 sites.
